pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. A — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
